chapter: Friends, New York life and recording routine
title: Bonnie Raitt and the Butter Beans and Susie song
summary: Wallace sings a line from a Susie song she does with Bonnie Raitt and talks about why Butter Beans and Susie were a hit and how Susie died.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
